content.text: {"scale_statement":"","scale_page":0,"cells":[{"key":"saas.mrr","page":1,"printed_figure":"$2,400,000","printed_label":"Monthly recurring revenue (MRR)","column_header":"As of October 31, 2026"},{"key":"saas.arr","page":1,"printed_figure":"$28,800,000","printed_label":"Annual recurring revenue (ARR)","column_header":"As of October 31, 2026"},{"key":"saas.net_new_arr","page":1,"printed_figure":"$509,232","printed_label":"Net new ARR in the month","column_header":"As of October 31, 2026"},{"key":"saas.customers","page":1,"printed_figure":"390","printed_label":"Customers","column_header":"As of October 31, 2026"},{"key":"saas.net_revenue_retention","page":1,"printed_figure":"108%","printed_label":"Net revenue retention, trailing 12 months","column_header":"As of October 31, 2026"}],"comparative_cells":[],"absent_keys":[],"notes":["The document is a monthly recurring revenue report, not a financial statement pack, so only the SaaS metric lines are reported; the income statement, balance sheet, cash flow and supplemental lines for the fiscal year to date are not in this document.","The report prints no prior-year comparative column; the trailing six months table and the MRR bridge rows (opening MRR, new customers, expansion, contraction, churn) fit no template line and were not reported.","No units phrase is printed; figures are shown in dollars with currency signs.","The document is marked as synthetic, for demonstration."]}
